queries.label: All modules
queries.blurb: Filter every node whose semantic.role is 'module'.

queries.label: All instances of module `fifo`
queries.blurb: Reverse-BFS over `of_module` edges landing on module:fifo. Result = instance nodes + their target.

queries.label: What drives port `fifo.full`?
queries.blurb: Reverse-BFS over `drives` edges from the `full` port. Multi-hop: walks back through every continuous-assign LHS chain.

queries.label: Sensitivity chains of every `always_ff` block
queries.blurb: Each always_ff procedural_block + every `sensitive_to` edge it owns. Animates one edge per signal.

queries.label: Cross-module: `top` reaches `fifo`
queries.blurb: Multi-hop path module:top -instantiates-> instance -of_module-> module:fifo. Animates each hop in sequence.

queries.label: All assertion-bearing constructs
queries.blurb: Nodes whose semantic.role is one of {assertion, property, sequence}.

queries.label: Class inheritance: every `extends` edge
queries.blurb: All class nodes plus every outgoing `extends` edge. Animates the edge from derived -> base.
